{"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=causal+guided+knowledge+editing+foundational+assumption+falsification+LLM&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.18653/v1/2026.acl-long.918\", \"title\": [\"CAKE: Causal-Guided Adaptive Knowledge Editing for LLMs\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2026.acl-long.918\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1016/j.oceaneng.2026.127496\", \"title\": [\"Knowledge graph construction and causal analysis for maritime safety: An HFACS-guided zero-shot LLM approach\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1016/j.oceaneng.2026.127496\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2026, 10]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.18653/v1/2025.acl-long.665\", \"title\": [\"ChainEdit: Propagating Ripple Effects in LLM Knowledge Editing through Logical Rule-Guided Chains\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.18653/v1/2025.acl-long.665\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2025]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.2139/ssrn.7571294\", \"title\": [\"CausalPT: Falsification-Guided Cascaded Pruning over a Causal Memory Graph for Autonomous Penetration Testing\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>Large language model (LLM) agents are becoming the mainstream implementation of automated penetration testing, yet existing systems exhibit four structural failure modes, namely rabbit holes, state dissolution, explore–exploit imbalance, and flag hallucination. This paper presents CausalPT, a penetration testing framework whose core knowledge representation is a dynamic causal memory graph (CMG). The CMG persists tool observations as facts, binds attack hypotheses to falsifiable predicates, and propagates falsification deterministically along causal edges, severing every descendant of a dead end in one pass. Four complementary mechanisms close the four failure modes. A cascaded pruning engine falsifies hypotheses and blocks all their downstream paths, curbing rabbit holes. Goal verification, using exact flag matching and three anti-cheat anchors, eliminates flag hallucination. CMG-driven context compression keeps critical memory intact across long horizons at zero LLM cost, resisting state dissolution.
